## Community-usefulness checklist

- [ ] Solves a recurring, real platform engineering task
- [ ] Org-agnostic: no company names, IDs, internal URLs or hard-coded conventions
- [ ] Every framework pillar is addressed in the alignment table, with trade-offs
- [ ] Non-obvious recommendations cite official provider docs; no `<!-- VERIFY -->` left
- [ ] Secure by default; plans or what-if before apply; confirms destructive or costly actions
- [ ] No deprecated or retired services, SKUs or CLI flags
- [ ] Tested with an agent; scenarios recorded in `examples/`
- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate_skills.py` passes
- [ ] Added to the README catalog and `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`
